use: Concept art only; not implemented screenshots or production sprite sheets

prompts.home:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape gameplay concept art for a 2D pixel-art browser RPG, mobile landscape HUD, 16:9 composition.
Primary request: a believable in-game screenshot showing a cozy home base, fishing, cooking and collected dungeon treasures. This is original concept art, not a screenshot of an existing game.
Scene/backdrop: a small woodland homestead at a quiet pond. A roof-hidden cutaway cottage shows a compact kitchen with a steaming stew pot, a crafting bench, and shelves displaying a glowing blue crystal and a curious leaf-shaped relic brought back from a dungeon. The cottage opens onto a small yard with a few herb planters, berry shrubs, a woodpile and a short wooden fishing pier. A modest path leads toward a distant mossy cave entrance. The home is warm, modest and lived in, not a grand castle.
Subject: exactly one playable adventurer, an anthropomorphic orange-and-cream tabby CAT standing upright on two legs, wearing a teal neckerchief, rust-brown tunic, small backpack and boots, fishing from the pier. Recognizable cat face, ears and tail, small chibi proportions with paws used like hands. No other people.
Style/medium: crisp crafted 2D pixel art with visible square pixel clusters, consistent pixel density, limited harmonious palette and restrained dithering. Top-down three-quarter orthographic tile-based RPG view, NOT isometric, NOT a side-view, NOT a painted illustration. Small readable character scale relative to the scene. Clear walkable paths and clear object silhouettes. Rich but playable scene detail.
Composition/framing: fill the image edge-to-edge with the game viewport, no device frame, no collage. Keep the character near center-right; the cutaway home and collected objects remain clearly visible. Minimal mobile HUD: small heart icons upper left, three item slots along the top, translucent movement pad lower left, one large circular fishing action button lower right and a smaller backpack button nearby. Keep controls away from the character and important world objects.
Lighting/mood: warm late-afternoon light, calm greens and honey wood, jewel-blue discoveries.
Text: no words, no letters, no title, no watermark. Icons only.
Constraints: original visual assets; no copied Stardew Valley map, character or interface. Visually demonstrate how treasures from exploration become part of the home. Render one coherent playable scene.
prompts.dungeon:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape gameplay concept art for the same kind of 2D pixel-art browser RPG, mobile landscape HUD, 16:9 composition.
Primary request: a believable in-game screenshot of a readable action encounter and a meaningful exploration fork in a mossy woodland dungeon. Original concept art, not an existing game's screenshot.
Scene/backdrop: a ruined underground chamber of warm gray stone with roots, ferns, tiny mushrooms and luminous turquoise mineral clusters. Broad uncluttered walkable floor. A left passage leads toward a shallow underground fishing pool and a closed small treasure chest. A right passage leads deeper past a big root-covered doorway. Simple environmental symbols near the passages suggest fishing and a dangerous deeper route without text.
Subject: exactly one playable adventurer, an anthropomorphic cream-colored floppy-eared DOG standing upright on two legs, wearing a teal neckerchief, rust-brown tunic, small backpack and boots. Recognizable dog muzzle, ears and tail, small chibi proportions with paws used like hands. The dog is near the middle of the chamber holding a short sword, dodging sideways away from one small moss-shell beetle. A single second small mushroom creature waits farther away. A broad amber wedge on the floor clearly telegraphs the beetle's upcoming attack, and the player is visibly outside its edge. A blue mineral fragment lies near an opened chest. No human characters.
Style/medium: crisp crafted 2D pixel art, consistent square pixel clusters and limited harmonious palette. Top-down three-quarter orthographic tile-based RPG view, NOT isometric, NOT painted, NOT 3D. Small readable player and enemies; clear floor space for dodge movement. Cozy adventure with mild danger, no gore. Match the homestead concept's character proportions, teal scarf, rust tunic and warm wood UI.
Composition/framing: full game viewport edge-to-edge, no device frame and no collage. Landscape 16:9. Minimal mobile HUD: heart icons upper left, one stew bowl buff icon nearby, a few backpack loot slots upper right; translucent movement pad lower left; one large sword action button lower right plus one smaller dodge button and a small potion button. The HUD never covers the player, telegraph or paths. No barrage of floating damage numbers.
Lighting/mood: cool teal cavern shadows, warm lantern pools and amber warning marks, high contrast on player and enemies.
Text: no words, no letters, no title, no watermark. Icons only.
Constraints: original visual assets, no copied Stardew Valley map, character or interface. Convey active exploration and collecting useful treasures, not an empty decorative scene. Render one coherent playable scene.
